newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telephone & Data Systems initiated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telephone & Data Systems initiated.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it initiated coverage of Telephone & Data Systems Inc with a rating of market performer for the intermediate term and outperform for the long term with aggressive suitability.

-- EVEREN said it likes the company's fundamentals, although investor sentiment about the stock appears to be quite negative. EVEREN said it believes it will take a significant capital restructuring for investors to see significant and sustainable appreciation in the stock. EVEREN added it does not currently believe such a restructuring will take place in the intermediate term.
-- EVEREN set its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for the company at $0.80 per share and its estimate for 1998 at $1.79.
-- Telephone & Data Systems provides cellular and landline telephone services in addition to paging operations.
-- The company's stock was up 3/8 Tuesday at 36.
